card.text: Explore Loge, a moon of Saturn, through its lightcurve-constrained shape approximation.

introduction.text: Loge’s shallow, noisy light curve gives a small minimum elongation and a tentative rotation period. This ellipsoid uses assumed polar depth and orientation. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Light-curve shape approximation
model.summary: Approximate ellipsoid adopting minimum equatorial ratio 1.04:1 under uniform reflectivity. Equal short axes and volume scaling are assumed. Orientation and phase are illustrative. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
